name: Neuron
例文: The neuron is the basic working unit of the brain.
例文翻译: 神经元是大脑的基本工作单元。

name: Potential
例文: Action potentials are essential for neural communication.
例文翻译: 动作电位对于神经通信至关重要。

name: Spike
例文: The system counts spikes to decode motor intent.
例文翻译: 系统通过计算脉冲来解码运动意图。

name: Dendrite
例文: Dendrites receive information from other neurons.
例文翻译: 树突接收来自其他神经元的信息。

name: Axon
例文: The axon transmits signals over long distances.
例文翻译: 轴突远距离传输信号。

name: Synapse
例文: Chemicals cross the synapse to relay signals.
例文翻译: 化学物质跨过突触以传递信号。

name: Adapt
例文: Neurons adapt to repetitive stimuli over time.
例文翻译: 神经元会随着时间的推移适应重复的刺激。

name: Plasticity
例文: Neural plasticity allows the brain to reorganize itself.
例文翻译: 神经可塑性使大脑能够重新组织自我。

name: Facilitation
例文: Synaptic facilitation enhances the post-synaptic response.
例文翻译: 突触易化增强了突触后反应。

name: Depression
例文: Long-term depression weakens specific synaptic connections.
例文翻译: 长时程抑制削弱了特定的突触连接。

name: Anatomy
例文: Functional anatomy helps locate the motor cortex.
例文翻译: 功能解剖学有助于定位运动皮层。

name: Stimulate
例文: Electrodes stimulate specific brain regions to restore sight.
例文翻译: 电极刺激特定的大脑区域以恢复视力。

name: Invasive
例文: Invasive sensors are placed directly into the brain tissue.
例文翻译: 侵入式传感器直接放置在大脑组织中。

name: Noninvasive
例文: EEG is a popular noninvasive brain imaging technique.
例文翻译: EEG 是一种流行的非侵入式脑成像技术。

name: Simultaneous
例文: The system allows simultaneous recording from multiple areas.
例文翻译: 该系统允许从多个区域进行同步记录。

name: Multielectrode
例文: Multielectrode arrays can record hundreds of neurons.
例文翻译: 多电极阵列可以记录数百个神经元。

name: Neurochip
例文: A neurochip can process neural signals in real-time.
例文翻译: 神经芯片可以实时处理神经信号。

name: Frequency
例文: Brain waves are categorized by their oscillation frequency.
例文翻译: 脑波根据其振荡频率进行分类。

name: Fourier
例文: Fourier analysis decomposes signals into frequency components.
例文翻译: 傅里叶分析将信号分解为频率分量。

name: Discrete
例文: The analog signal is sampled into a discrete time series.
例文翻译: 模拟信号被采样为离散时间序列。

name: Spectral
例文: Spectral power increases during specific cognitive tasks.
例文翻译: 在特定的认知任务期间，谱功率会增加。

name: Feature
例文: Feature extraction reduces the dimensionality of the data.
例文翻译: 特征提取降低了数据的维度。

name: Wavelet
例文: Wavelet transform is ideal for analyzing transient spikes.
例文翻译: 小波变换是分析瞬时脉冲的理想选择。

name: Hjorth
例文: Hjorth parameters describe the dynamics of EEG signals.
例文翻译: 赫斯参数描述了 EEG 信号的动力学。

name: Fractal
例文: Fractal dimension can measure the complexity of brain activity.
例文翻译: 分形维度可以衡量大脑活动的复杂性。

name: Autoregressive
例文: An autoregressive model predicts signals based on past values.
例文翻译: 自回归模型基于过去的值预测信号。

name: Bayesian
例文: Bayesian decoders update intent based on prior probability.
例文翻译: 贝叶斯解码器根据先验概率更新意图。

name: Kalman
例文: A Kalman filter provides smooth tracking for cursor control.
例文翻译: 卡尔曼滤波器为光标控制提供平滑的追踪。

name: Particle
例文: Particle filters are used for nonlinear state estimation.
例文翻译: 粒子滤波器用于非线性状态估计。

name: Spatial
例文: Spatial filters improve the localization of neural sources.
例文翻译: 空间滤波器提高了神经源的定位。

name: Bipolar
例文: Bipolar recording reduces common-mode noise.
例文翻译: 双极记录减少了共模噪声。

name: Laplacian
例文: A Laplacian filter enhances local spatial resolution.
例文翻译: 拉普拉斯滤波器增强了局部空间分辨率。

name: Reference
例文: Proper referencing is crucial for clean EEG data.
例文翻译: 正确的参考对于获取干净的 EEG 数据至关重要。

name: Component
例文: Independent component analysis separates neural artifacts.
例文翻译: 独立成分分析可以分离神经伪迹。

name: Pattern
例文: Machine learning identifies patterns in neural firing.
例文翻译: 机器学习识别神经放电中的模式。

name: Artifact
例文: Eye blinks are a common artifact in brain recordings.
例文翻译: 眨眼是脑记录中常见的伪迹。

name: Reduction
例文: Artifact reduction is a key step in pre-processing.
例文翻译: 伪迹消除是预处理的关键步骤。

name: Threshold
例文: A spike is detected when the signal crosses a threshold.
例文翻译: 当信号超过阈值时，就会检测到一个脉冲。

name: Notch
例文: A notch filter removes power line interference.
例文翻译: 陷波滤波器去除电源线干扰。

name: Ensemble
例文: An ensemble of classifiers often yields higher accuracy.
例文翻译: 分类器集成通常能产生更高的准确率。

name: Classification
例文: Linear classification is used to distinguish brain states.
例文翻译: 线性分类用于区分大脑状态。

name: Evaluation
例文: Cross-validation is used for performance evaluation.
例文翻译: 交叉验证用于性能评估。

name: Performance
例文: Information transfer rate measures BCI performance.
例文翻译: 信息传输率衡量脑机接口的性能。

name: Regression
例文: Regression models map neural data to continuous movement.
例文翻译: 回归模型将神经数据映射到连续运动。

name: Backpropagation
例文: Backpropagation is used to train deep neural networks.
例文翻译: 反向传播用于训练深度神经网络。

name: Radial
例文: Radial basis functions are used in nonlinear kernels.
例文翻译: 径向基函数用于非线性核中。

name: Gaussian
例文: The noise distribution is often modeled as Gaussian.
例文翻译: 噪声分布通常被建模为高斯分布。

name: Condition
例文: Operant conditioning helps users control their brain waves.
例文翻译: 操作性条件反射帮助用户控制他们的脑波。

name: Population
例文: Population coding involves the activity of many neurons.
例文翻译: 群体编码涉及许多神经元的活动。

name: Imagine
例文: Users can imagine movement to control a robotic arm.
例文翻译: 用户可以通过想象动作来控制机械臂。

name: Motor
例文: The primary motor cortex controls voluntary movement.
例文翻译: 初级运动皮层控制随意运动。

name: Cognitive
例文: Cognitive load can affect the accuracy of a BCI.
例文翻译: 认知负荷会影响脑机接口的准确性。

name: Stimulus-Evoked
例文: P300 is a well-known stimulus-evoked potential.
例文翻译: P300 是一种著名的刺激诱发电位。

name: Paradigm
例文: The P300 speller is a classic BCI paradigm.
例文翻译: P300 拼写器是一个经典的脑机接口范式。

name: Decode
例文: Algorithms decode brain signals into control commands.
例文翻译: 算法将大脑信号解码为控制指令。

name: Prosthetic
例文: A prosthetic limb can be controlled via neural interfaces.
例文翻译: 假肢可以通过神经接口进行控制。

name: Cursor
例文: The user moved the computer cursor using only thought.
例文翻译: 用户仅凭思维移动电脑光标。

name: Formation
例文: Neural formation occurs during early development.
例文翻译: 神经形成发生在地早期发育阶段。

name: Cortical
例文: Cortical maps represent different parts of the body.
例文翻译: 皮层映射代表身体的不同部分。

name: Implant
例文: A brain implant can bypass damaged spinal nerves.
例文翻译: 大脑植入物可以绕过受损的脊神经。

name: Electrocorticographic
例文: ECoG provides better signal quality than scalp EEG.
例文翻译: ECoG 提供比头皮 EEG 更好的信号质量。

name: Peripheral
例文: Peripheral nerve interfaces can control hand prostheses.
例文翻译: 外周神经接口可以控制手部假体。

name: Reinnervation
例文: Targeted muscle reinnervation helps amputees.
例文翻译: 靶向肌肉神经再支配帮助截肢者。

name: Oscillatory
例文: Oscillatory activity reflects rhythmic neural firing.
例文翻译: 振荡活动反映了节律性的神经放电。

name: Coadaptive
例文: Coadaptive BCI updates both the user and the machine.
例文翻译: 共适应脑机接口同时更新用户和机器。

name: Hierarchical
例文: The brain uses a hierarchical system for motor control.
例文翻译: 大脑使用层级系统进行运动控制。

name: Magnetoencephalography
例文: MEG measures the magnetic fields produced by the brain.
例文翻译: MEG 测量大脑产生的磁场。

name: Infrared
例文: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy measures blood flow.
例文翻译: 功能性近红外光谱测量血流量。

name: Optical
例文: Optical imaging provides a non-invasive view of the cortex.
例文翻译: 光学成像提供皮层的非侵入式视角。

name: Sensory
例文: Sensory feedback is essential for natural movement.
例文翻译: 感觉反馈对于自然运动至关重要。

name: Restoration
例文: The goal of BCI is the restoration of lost function.
例文翻译: 脑机接口的目标是恢复失去的功能。

name: Cochlear
例文: Cochlear implants restore hearing to the deaf.
例文翻译: 耳蜗植入物为失聪者恢复听力。

name: Retinal
例文: Retinal implants can provide basic visual perception.
例文翻译: 视网膜植入物可以提供基础的视觉感知。

name: Augmentation
例文: BCI can be used for sensory augmentation.
例文翻译: 脑机接口可用于感觉增强。

name: Bidirectional
例文: A bidirectional BCI both records and stimulates.
例文翻译: 双向脑机接口既记录又刺激。

name: Recurrent
例文: Recurrent neural networks are good for temporal data.
例文翻译: 循环神经网络擅长时间序列数据。

name: Tactile
例文: Tactile stimulation provides feedback from a robotic hand.
例文翻译: 触觉刺激提供来自机械手的反馈。

name: Somatosensory
例文: The somatosensory cortex processes touch information.
例文翻译: 躯体感觉皮层处理触摸信息。

name: Ethics
例文: Ethics is a major concern in neural engineering.
例文翻译: 伦理是神经工程中的一个主要关注点。

name: Rehabilitation
例文: BCI aids in the rehabilitation of stroke patients.
例文翻译: 脑机接口辅助中风患者的康复。

name: Wheelchair
例文: Mind-controlled wheelchairs offer more independence.
例文翻译: 思维控制的轮椅提供更多独立性。

name: Navigate
例文: The avatar can navigate through a virtual world.
例文翻译: 虚拟化身可以在虚拟世界中导航。

name: Throughput
例文: High throughput is needed for complex BCI control.
例文翻译: 复杂的脑机接口控制需要高吞吐量。

name: Monitor
例文: We can monitor alertness levels during long tasks.
例文翻译: 我们可以在长时间任务中监测警觉程度。

name: Authentication
例文: Brainwaves can serve as a form of authentication.
例文翻译: 脑波可以作为一种身份认证形式。

name: Exoskeleton
例文: An exoskeleton supports the user's physical movements.
例文翻译: 外骨骼支持用户的肢体动作。

name: Mnemonic
例文: Mnemonic devices help in encoding information.
例文翻译: 记忆装置有助于编码信息。

name: Consent
例文: Informed consent is a core principle of medical ethics.
例文翻译: 知情同意是医学伦理的核心原则。

name: Privacy
例文: Neural privacy must be protected from unauthorized access.
例文翻译: 神经隐私必须受到保护，防止未经授权的访问。

name: Bernoulli
例文: The trial follows a Bernoulli distribution.
例文翻译: 该试验遵循伯努利分布。

name: Evolve
例文: The brain has evolved over millions of years.
例文翻译: 大脑经过数百万年的进化。

name: Millennium
例文: Neural structures have remained stable for a millennium.
例文翻译: 神经结构在千年间保持稳定。

name: Tinker
例文: Evolution tends to tinker with existing structures.
例文翻译: 进化倾向于对现有结构进行修补。

name: Interdisciplinary
例文: BCI is a highly interdisciplinary field.
例文翻译: 脑机接口是一个高度跨学科的领域。

name: Leverage
例文: We leverage machine learning to decode signals.
例文翻译: 我们利用机器学习来解码信号。

name: Stimoceiver
例文: The stimoceiver was an early implantable BCI device.
例文翻译: 刺激接收器是一种早期的植入式脑机接口设备。

name: Caudate
例文: The caudate nucleus is part of the basal ganglia.
例文翻译: 尾状核是基底节的一部分。

name: Nucleus
例文: The nucleus processes incoming sensory information.
例文翻译: 神经核处理输入的感官信息。

name: Symptom
例文: BCI can help manage the symptoms of ALS.
例文翻译: 脑机接口可以帮助管理渐冻症的症状。

name: Debilitating
例文: Stroke is a debilitating condition for many patients.
例文翻译: 中风对许多患者来说是一种使人衰弱的状况。

name: Amputee
例文: Amputees can regain control through neural interfaces.
例文翻译: 截肢者可以通过神经接口重新获得控制。

name: Sclerosis
例文: ALS is a progressive neurodegenerative disease.
例文翻译: ALS 是一种进展性的神经退行性疾病。

name: Paralyze
例文: A spinal injury can paralyze the lower limbs.
例文翻译: 脊髓损伤会使下肢瘫痪。

name: Synthesize
例文: The computer can synthesize artificial feedback.
例文翻译: 计算机可以合成人工反馈。

name: Unsurpassed
例文: Human brain efficiency remains unsurpassed.
例文翻译: 人脑的效率仍然是无可比拟的。

name: despite
例文: Despite the noise the signal was clear.
例文翻译: 尽管存在噪声，信号依然清晰。

name: capability
例文: The brain has an immense processing capability.
例文翻译: 大脑具有巨大的处理能力。

name: massive
例文: The brain is a massively parallel processor.
例文翻译: 大脑是一个大规模并行处理器。

name: parallel
例文: Parallel processing allows for high-speed computation.
例文翻译: 并行处理允许高速计算。

name: workhorse
例文: The neuron is the workhorse of the nervous system.
例文翻译: 神经元是神经系统的核心主力。

name: electrochemical
例文: Neural communication is an electrochemical process.
例文翻译: 神经通信是一个电化学过程。

name: convey
例文: Axons convey signals to other neurons.
例文翻译: 轴突将信号传递给其他神经元。

name: plastic
例文: The brain is highly plastic during development.
例文翻译: 大脑在发育过程中具有高度的可塑性。

name: circumstance
例文: Synaptic strength changes under various circumstances.
例文翻译: 突触强度在各种情况下会发生变化。

name: von Neumann architecture
例文: Computers are based on the von Neumann architecture.
例文翻译: 计算机基于冯·诺依曼架构。

name: primer
例文: This book serves as a primer on neuroscience.
例文翻译: 这本书是神经科学的入门读物。

name: synapse
例文: Information is transmitted across the synapse.
例文翻译: 信息通过突触传递。

name: architecture
例文: The brain architecture is complex and hierarchical.
例文翻译: 大脑架构复杂且具有层级结构。

name: regard
例文: The neuron is regarded as the basic unit of life.
例文翻译: 神经元被认为是生命的基本单位。

name: crude
例文: This model is a crude approximation of reality.
例文翻译: 这个模型是对现实的粗略近似。

name: approximation
例文: The simulation is a close approximation of neural activity.
例文翻译: 该模拟是对神经活动的高度近似。

name: leaky
例文: A leaky membrane affects the time constant.
例文翻译: 有泄漏的膜会影响时间常数。

name: charge
例文: Ions carry positive or negative charges.
例文翻译: 离子携带正电荷或负电荷。

name: membrane
例文: The cell membrane regulates the flow of ions.
例文翻译: 细胞膜调节离子的流动。

name: lipid
例文: The membrane is composed of a lipid bilayer.
例文翻译: 膜由脂质双分子层组成。

name: impermeable
例文: The lipid bilayer is impermeable to most ions.
例文翻译: 脂质双分子层对大多数离子是不渗透的。

name: ionic channel
例文: Ionic channels allow specific ions to pass through.
例文翻译: 离子通道允许特定离子通过。

name: dance
例文: The complex dance of ions creates action potentials.
例文翻译: 离子的复杂交互产生了动作电位。

name: depict
例文: The diagram depicts the structure of a neuron.
例文翻译: 该图描绘了神经元的结构。

name: concentration
例文: The ion concentration is different inside and outside.
例文翻译: 内外离子浓度不同。

name: sodium
例文: Sodium ions flow into the cell during excitation.
例文翻译: 兴奋时钠离子流入细胞。

name: chloride
例文: Chloride ions contribute to inhibitory potentials.
例文翻译: 氯离子有助于抑制性电位。

name: calcium
例文: Calcium is vital for neurotransmitter release.
例文翻译: 钙对于神经递质的释放至关重要。

name: potassium
例文: Potassium channels help restore the resting potential.
例文翻译: 钾通道有助于恢复静息电位。

name: anion
例文: Organic anions stay inside the cell membrane.
例文翻译: 有机阴离子留在细胞膜内。

name: pump
例文: Sodium-potassium pumps maintain the ion gradient.
例文翻译: 钠钾泵维持离子梯度。

name: approximate
例文: The membrane potential is approximately -70mV.
例文翻译: 膜电位大约为 -70mV。

name: protein
例文: Proteins reside within the lipid bilayer.
例文翻译: 蛋白质存在于脂质双分子层中。

name: reside
例文: Membrane proteins reside in the cell surface.
例文翻译: 膜蛋白存在于细胞表面。

name: aqueous
例文: Ions are dissolved in an aqueous medium.
例文翻译: 离子溶解在水性介质中。

name: medium
例文: The extracellular medium is rich in sodium.
例文翻译: 细胞外介质富含钠。

name: sufficient
例文: A sufficient stimulus triggers an action potential.
例文翻译: 足够的刺激会触发动作电位。

name: cascade
例文: Signal transduction involves a molecular cascade.
例文翻译: 信号转导涉及分子级联。

name: influx
例文: A rapid influx of sodium depolarizes the cell.
例文翻译: 钠离子的快速流入使细胞去极化。

name: outflux
例文: The outflux of potassium repolarizes the membrane.
例文翻译: 钾离子的流出使膜复极化。

name: rapid
例文: The action potential is a rapid change in voltage.
例文翻译: 动作电位是电压的快速变化。

name: represent
例文: A spike represents a single neural event.
例文翻译: 脉冲代表单个神经事件。

name: dominant
例文: Sodium is the dominant ion during the rising phase.
例文翻译: 在上升相，钠是占主导地位的离子。

name: stereotype
例文: Action potentials are stereotyped signals.
例文翻译: 动作电位是定型（规格统一）的信号。

name: extracellular
例文: Extracellular recording is less invasive.
例文翻译: 细胞外记录的侵入性较小。

name: sequence
例文: The sequence of spikes encodes information.
例文翻译: 脉冲序列编码信息。

name: stereotypical
例文: The waveform of a spike is stereotypical.
例文翻译: 脉冲的波形是定型的。

name: ramp
例文: A slow ramp in potential leads to the threshold.
例文翻译: 电位的缓慢上升导向阈值。

name: threshold
例文: The neuron fires when it reaches the threshold.
例文翻译: 神经元达到阈值时放电。

name: fire
例文: The neuron begins to fire rapidly.
例文翻译: 神经元开始快速放电。

name: morphological
例文: Morphological diversity reflects functional roles.
例文翻译: 形态多样性反映了功能角色。

name: soma
例文: The soma contains the nucleus of the neuron.
例文翻译: 胞体包含神经元的细胞核。

name: dendrite
例文: Dendrites integrate incoming synaptic inputs.
例文翻译: 树突整合输入的突触信号。

name: initiate
例文: The action potential is initiated at the axon hillock.
例文翻译: 动作电位在轴突始段发起。

name: propagate
例文: The signal propagates along the axon.
例文翻译: 信号沿着轴突传播。

name: myelin
例文: Myelin acts as an insulator for the axon.
例文翻译: 髓鞘作为轴突的绝缘体。

name: sheath
例文: The myelin sheath speeds up signal transmission.
例文翻译: 髓鞘加快了信号传输速度。

name: boost
例文: Nodes of Ranvier boost the signal propagation.
例文翻译: 朗飞氏结增强了信号传播。

name: term
例文: In biological terms the brain is a complex organ.
例文翻译: 在生物学角度上，大脑是一个复杂的器官。

name: myelinated
例文: Myelinated fibers conduct signals faster.
例文翻译: 有髓鞘纤维传导信号更快。

name: cleft
例文: The synaptic cleft is the space between neurons.
例文翻译: 突触间隙是神经元之间的空间。

name: presynaptic
例文: Neurotransmitters are released from the presynaptic terminal.
例文翻译: 神经递质从突触前末梢释放。

name: postsynaptic
例文: The postsynaptic membrane contains receptors.
例文翻译: 突触后膜包含受体。

name: neurotransmitter
例文: Neurotransmitters relay signals across synapses.
例文翻译: 神经递质在突触间传递信号。

name: vesicle
例文: Synaptic vesicles store neurotransmitters.
例文翻译: 突触囊泡储存神经递质。

name: receptor
例文: Receptors bind to specific neurotransmitters.
例文翻译: 受体与特定的神经递质结合。

name: excitatory
例文: Glutamate is the main excitatory neurotransmitter.
例文翻译: 谷氨酸是主要的兴奋性神经递质。

name: inhibitory
例文: GABA is a major inhibitory neurotransmitter.
例文翻译: GABA 是主要的抑制性神经递质。

name: excitatory postsynaptic potential
例文: The EPSP increases the probability of firing.
例文翻译: EPSP 增加了放电概率。

name: interneuron
例文: Interneurons connect different neural circuits.
例文翻译: 中间神经元连接不同的神经回路。

name: desire
例文: The user has a desired movement in mind.
例文翻译: 用户心中有一个预期的动作。

name: emit
例文: The neuron emits a sequence of pulses.
例文翻译: 神经元发出一段脉冲序列。

name: hybrid
例文: The brain uses a hybrid analog-digital code.
例文翻译: 大脑使用模拟-数字混合编码。

name: ignore
例文: The model ignores small fluctuations in voltage.
例文翻译: 该模型忽略了电压的小幅波动。

name: associate
例文: Memory is associated with synaptic changes.
例文翻译: 记忆与突触变化相关。

name: plasticity
例文: Synaptic plasticity is key to learning.
例文翻译: 突触可塑性是学习的关键。

name: critical
例文: Timing is critical for synaptic potentiation.
例文翻译: 时机对于突触增强至关重要。

name: component
例文: Plasticity is a critical component of adaptation.
例文翻译: 可塑性是适应的关键组成部分。

name: potentiation
例文: Long-term potentiation strengthens synapses.
例文翻译: 长时程增强强化了突触。

name: depression
例文: Long-term depression weakens synaptic signals.
例文翻译: 长时程抑制削弱了突触信号。

name: dependent
例文: Plasticity is often activity-dependent.
例文翻译: 可塑性通常是活动依赖性的。

name: polarity
例文: The polarity of the change depends on the timing.
例文翻译: 变化的极性取决于时机。

name: facilitation
例文: Short-term facilitation lasts for seconds.
例文翻译: 短时程易化持续数秒。

name: correlate
例文: Firing rates correlate with movement speed.
例文翻译: 放电率与运动速度相关。

name: implementation
例文: The physical implementation of memory is synaptic.
例文翻译: 记忆的物理实现是突触性的。

name: postulate
例文: Hebb's postulate explains synaptic strengthening.
例文翻译: 赫布假说解释了突触强化。

name: consistent
例文: Consistent firing leads to stronger connections.
例文翻译: 持续一致的放电导致更强的连接。

name: hippocampus
例文: The hippocampus is essential for memory formation.
例文翻译: 海马体对于记忆形成至关重要。

name: neocortex
例文: The neocortex is involved in higher functions.
例文翻译: 新皮层涉及高级功能。

name: cerebellum
例文: The cerebellum coordinates voluntary movements.
例文翻译: 小脑协调随意运动。

name: protocol
例文: The researchers used a strict stimulation protocol.
例文翻译: 研究人员使用了严格的刺激方案。

name: demonstrate
例文: The study demonstrates synaptic scaling.
例文翻译: 该研究证明了突触缩放。

name: simultaneous
例文: Simultaneous firing strengthens the synapse.
例文翻译: 同时放电强化了突触。

name: precise
例文: Precise timing is required for STDP.
例文翻译: STDP 需要精确的时机。

name: occur
例文: Changes occur at the molecular level.
例文翻译: 变化发生在分子层面。

name: phenomenon
例文: LTP is a well-studied neural phenomenon.
例文翻译: LTP 是一个经过深入研究的神经现象。

name: vice versa
例文: Strong input leads to LTP and vice versa.
例文翻译: 强输入导致 LTP，反之亦然。

name: particular
例文: This effect is particularly strong in the cortex.
例文翻译: 这种效应在皮层中特别强。

name: ephemeral
例文: Short-term plasticity is an ephemeral effect.
例文翻译: 短时程可塑性是一种短暂的效应。

name: temporal
例文: Temporal summation occurs at the dendrites.
例文翻译: 时间总和发生在树突处。

name: diminish
例文: The response diminishes after repeated stimuli.
例文翻译: 重复刺激后反应减弱。

name: burst
例文: A burst of spikes can trigger potentiation.
例文翻译: 脉冲爆发可以触发增强。

name: subsequent
例文: Subsequent inputs produce a smaller response.
例文翻译: 随后的输入产生较小的反应。

name: predecessor
例文: The neuron's activity influences its predecessor.
例文翻译: 神经元的活动影响其前身。

name: cortical
例文: Cortical neurons are organized in layers.
例文翻译: 皮层神经元按层组织。

name: anatomy
例文: Neuroanatomy is the study of brain structure.
例文翻译: 神经解剖学是研究大脑结构的学科。

name: treatment
例文: The treatment focuses on restoring motor function.
例文翻译: 治疗重点在于恢复运动功能。

name: broad
例文: The nervous system is broadly divided into two parts.
例文翻译: 神经系统大致分为两部分。

name: peripheral
例文: The peripheral nervous system connects to limbs.
例文翻译: 外周神经系统连接到四肢。

name: somatic
例文: The somatic system controls voluntary muscles.
例文翻译: 躯体系统控制随意肌。

name: autonomic
例文: The autonomic system regulates internal organs.
例文翻译: 自主神经系统调节内脏器官。

name: spinal cord
例文: The spinal cord carries signals to the brain.
例文翻译: 脊髓将信号传导至大脑。

name: descending
例文: Descending pathways carry motor commands.
例文翻译: 下行通路携带运动指令。

name: ascending
例文: Ascending pathways carry sensory information.
例文翻译: 上行通路携带感觉信息。

name: reflex
例文: Reflexes are rapid and involuntary responses.
例文翻译: 反射是快速且无意识的反应。

name: withdrawal
例文: The withdrawal reflex protects us from pain.
例文翻译: 撤退反射保护我们免受疼痛。

name: nucleus
例文: A nucleus is a cluster of neurons in the CNS.
例文翻译: 神经核是中枢神经系统中的神经元集群。

name: cluster
例文: Neurons cluster together to form functional units.
例文翻译: 神经元聚集在一起形成功能单元。

name: medulla
例文: The medulla controls autonomic functions like breathing.
例文翻译: 延髓控制呼吸等自主功能。

name: pons
例文: The pons relays signals between the cortex and cerebellum.
例文翻译: 脑桥在皮层和小脑之间传递信号。

name: midbrain
例文: The midbrain is involved in vision and hearing.
例文翻译: 中脑涉及视觉和听觉。

name: constitute
例文: These structures constitute the brainstem.
例文翻译: 这些结构构成了脑干。

name: stem
例文: The brain stem connects the brain to the spinal cord.
例文翻译: 脑干将大脑与脊髓连接起来。

name: hypothalamus
例文: The hypothalamus regulates body temperature.
例文翻译: 下丘脑调节体温。

name: thalamus
例文: The thalamus acts as a sensory relay station.
例文翻译: 丘脑作为感觉中继站。

name: diencephalon
例文: The diencephalon includes the thalamus and hypothalamus.
例文翻译: 间脑包括丘脑和下丘脑。

name: relay
例文: The thalamus relays information to the cortex.
例文翻译: 丘脑将信息传递到皮层。

name: cerebral cortex
例文: The cerebral cortex is responsible for cognition.
例文翻译: 大脑皮层负责认知。

name: neocortex
例文: The neocortex is involved in higher-order brain functions.
例文翻译: 新皮层参与高级脑功能。

name: hippocampus
例文: The hippocampus plays a major role in spatial memory.
例文翻译: 海马体在空间记忆中起着重要作用。

name: perception
例文: Sensory perception is the process of interpreting stimuli.
例文翻译: 感觉感知是解释刺激的过程。

name: cognition
例文: BCI technology aims to enhance human cognition.
例文翻译: 脑机接口技术旨在增强人类认知。

name: medulla
例文: The medulla regulates autonomic functions like heart rate.
例文翻译: 延髓调节心率等自主功能。

name: inferior
例文: The inferior colliculus is a part of the auditory system.
例文翻译: 下丘是听觉系统的一部分。

name: superior
例文: The superior colliculus coordinates eye movements.
例文翻译: 上丘协调眼球运动。

name: colliculus
例文: The colliculus is located in the midbrain.
例文翻译: 丘状体位于中脑。

name: tegmentum
例文: The tegmentum contains several nuclei involved in motor control.
例文翻译: 被盖包含若干参与运动控制的神经核。

name: reticular
例文: The reticular formation regulates sleep-wake cycles.
例文翻译: 网状结构调节睡眠-觉醒周期。

name: nucleus
例文: The lateral geniculate nucleus relays visual information.
例文翻译: 外侧膝状体核中继视觉信息。

name: diencephalon
例文: The diencephalon acts as a primary relay for sensory data.
例文翻译: 间脑作为感觉数据的初级中继。

name: thalamus
例文: Almost all sensory signals pass through the thalamus.
例文翻译: 几乎所有的感觉信号都经过丘脑。

name: hypothalamus
例文: The hypothalamus links the nervous system to the endocrine system.
例文翻译: 下丘脑将神经系统与内分泌系统联系起来。

name: relay
例文: Thalamic nuclei relay signals to the cerebral cortex.
例文翻译: 丘脑核将信号传递到大脑皮层。

name: organ
例文: The ear is the primary organ for hearing.
例文翻译: 耳朵是主要的听觉器官。

name: olfaction
例文: Olfaction is the only sense that bypasses the thalamus.
例文翻译: 嗅觉是唯一绕过丘脑的感觉。

name: bypass
例文: Information bypasses the traditional sensory relay station.
例文翻译: 信息绕过了传统的感觉中继站。

name: olfactory
例文: The olfactory bulb processes chemical signals from the nose.
例文翻译: 嗅球处理来自鼻子的化学信号。

name: cortex
例文: The cerebral cortex is divided into four lobes.
例文翻译: 大脑皮层分为四个叶。

name: cortico
例文: The corticospinal tract is a major motor pathway.
例文翻译: 皮层脊髓束是主要的运动通路。

name: cerebral
例文: The cerebral hemispheres are connected by the corpus callosum.
例文翻译: 大脑半球由胼胝体连接。

name: hemisphere
例文: The left hemisphere is often dominant for language.
例文翻译: 左半球通常在语言方面占主导地位。

name: ganglion
例文: The basal ganglion is involved in movement coordination.
例文翻译: 基底节参与运动协调。

name: amygdala
例文: The amygdala is key to processing emotional responses.
例文翻译: 杏仁核是处理情感反应的关键。

name: spatial
例文: Spatial cognition allows us to navigate the environment.
例文翻译: 空间认知使我们能够导航环境。

name: convoluted
例文: The convoluted surface increases the brain's area.
例文翻译: 褶皱的表面增加了大脑的面积。

name: reside
例文: Many specialized neurons reside in the neocortex.
例文翻译: 许多特化神经元存在于新皮层中。

name: pyramidal
例文: Pyramidal cells are the primary output of the cortex.
例文翻译: 锥体细胞是皮层的主要输出。

name: orient
例文: Cells in the visual cortex are oriented to specific bars.
例文翻译: 视觉皮层的细胞对特定条纹具有定向性。

name: fissure
例文: The longitudinal fissure separates the two hemispheres.
例文翻译: 纵裂将两个半球分开。

name: sulcus
例文: A sulcus is a groove on the surface of the brain.
例文翻译: 沟是大脑表面的一种凹槽。

name: ridge
例文: The ridges on the brain's surface are called gyri.
例文翻译: 大脑表面的脊被称为脑回。

name: gyrus
例文: The precentral gyrus contains the primary motor cortex.
例文翻译: 前中央回包含初级运动皮层。

name: occipital
例文: The occipital lobe is responsible for visual processing.
例文翻译: 枕叶负责视觉处理。

name: parietal
例文: The parietal lobe integrates sensory information.
例文翻译: 顶叶整合感觉信息。

name: reasoning
例文: Frontal lobes are essential for logical reasoning.
例文翻译: 前额叶对逻辑推理至关重要。

name: temporal
例文: The temporal lobe is involved in auditory perception.
例文翻译: 颞叶涉及听觉感知。

name: frontal
例文: The frontal lobe manages complex executive functions.
例文翻译: 额叶管理复杂的执行功能。

name: cortical
例文: Cortical layers have distinct cellular compositions.
例文翻译: 皮层各层具有不同的细胞组成。

name: predominantly
例文: The motor cortex is predominantly involved in movement.
例文翻译: 运动皮层主要涉及运动。

name: hierarchically
例文: The visual system is organized hierarchically.
例文翻译: 视觉系统是按层级组织的。

name: retina
例文: Light is converted into neural signals in the retina.
例文翻译: 光在视网膜中转化为神经信号。

name: lateral
例文: The lateral pathway carries signals to the limbs.
例文翻译: 侧向通路将信号传导至四肢。

name: geniculate
例文: The geniculate nucleus is a key relay for vision.
例文翻译: 膝状核是视觉的关键中继点。

name: bar
例文: Some neurons respond specifically to oriented bars.
例文翻译: 某些神经元专门对定向条纹做出反应。

name: inferotemporal
例文: The inferotemporal cortex is key for object recognition.
例文翻译: 下颞叶皮层是物体识别的关键。

name: ventral
例文: The ventral stream is often called the 'what' pathway.
例文翻译: 腹侧流通常被称为“识别（what）”通路。

name: stream
例文: Visual information flows through two major streams.
例文翻译: 视觉信息流经两个主要通路。

name: dorsal
例文: The dorsal stream processes spatial location.
例文翻译: 背侧流处理空间位置。

name: somatosensory
例文: The somatosensory cortex processes touch and pain.
例文翻译: 躯体感觉皮层处理触摸和疼痛。

name: gustatory
例文: The gustatory cortex is responsible for the sense of taste.
例文翻译: 味觉皮层负责味觉。

name: supplementary
例文: The supplementary motor area helps plan complex moves.
例文翻译: 辅助运动区帮助规划复杂的动作。

name: correspond
例文: Certain brain areas correspond to specific body parts.
例文翻译: 某些大脑区域对应特定的身体部位。

name: scheme
例文: The coding scheme represents how data is stored.
例文翻译: 编码方案代表了数据是如何存储的。

name: mediate
例文: Synaptic changes mediate the formation of memories.
例文翻译: 突触变化介导了记忆的形成。

name: fundamentally
例文: Neural circuits are fundamentally adaptive.
例文翻译: 神经回路从根本上说是具有适应性的。

name: volley
例文: A volley of impulses is sent down the nerve fiber.
例文翻译: 一簇脉冲沿着神经纤维发送。

name: prominent
例文: The central sulcus is a prominent feature of the brain.
例文翻译: 中央沟是大脑的一个显著特征。
